title: Moral Lenses, Political Coordinates: Towards Ideological Positioning of Morally Conditioned LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating ideological shifts by conditioning Large Language Models to endorse or reject specific moral values (e.g., utilitarianism, deontology, and Moral Foundations Theory dimensions) and measuring their resulting responses to the 62 propositions of the Political Compass Test (PCT) along economic (left/right) and social (libertarian/authoritarian) axes.
